correctness.rationale: The determinant expansion gives a coefficient xy-av for the third free entry. The q²-q+1 generic pairs give exactly one solution each; q-1 exceptional pairs reduce bijectively to a monic quadratic with nonzero constant term, with exactly 1+chi(discriminant) roots. This gives the full fiber formula. For t=0 the discriminant is (D-T)², and a standard q-1 factorization proves the character-sum identity and level frequencies. The exact checker passed 24,128 target-fiber comparisons across 4,544 parameter choices in five odd finite fields, including F9.

value.rationale: Six fixed entries are the two disjoint permutation cycle covers of a three-vertex directed cycle, a canonical first nonrectangular prescribed-entry setting. The evaluated invariant distinguishes three exact quadratic-character levels for each determinant and yields an exact singular-completion dichotomy depending only on whether the two fixed cycle products agree. This is a meaningful structural classification over all odd finite fields, not an arbitrary fixed modulus or simple restatement of diagonal marginals.
